furniturePage.introduction: Connect the shopper’s space and practical needs to facts your team can verify.
furniturePage.diagramNote: A relationship diagram, not a measured product or a fit result.
furniturePage.relationshipTitle: A product has to fit more than a room.

relationships.title: Space and use
relationships.body: Dimensions and capacity describe the product in readable, verifiable terms.

relationships.title: Material and finish
relationships.body: Keep frame, upholstery and finish separate, including the selected variant.

relationships.title: Arrival and return
relationships.body: Assembly, delivery and returns belong beside the product facts.

questionNotes: Keep exact product measurements separate from illustrative photos.
Check the selected variant’s material, price and availability alongside its capacity.
Verify suitability for the exact product with the supplier. The illustration does not establish compatibility.
